ai_overview_references.title: Directory Listings Affect AI Visibility in One Narrow Way - LinkedIn

answer_text:
According to published research from LinkedIn Pulse (Directory Listings Affect AI Visibility in One Narrow Way), Perplexity cited 73 different web domains across its responses when tracking local business recommendation questions (such as plumber inquiries between September 14 and October 13, 2026). LinkedIn·Saihajpreet Singh
